chunks: And when I inspired the disciples to believe in Me and My apostle, they said: 'We believe, and You bear witness that we submit.'

key_terms.الْحَوَارِيِّينَ: The disciples of Jesus (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What did the disciples of Jesus say when inspired to believe in him and God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the continuity of prophetic mission, where Jesus (peace be upon him) and his disciples (al-Hawariyyun) affirm their submission to God, often interpreted as anticipating the finality of Prophet Muhammad’s (peace be upon him and him) message. The term 'Muslim' here denotes those who submit to God’s will, reinforcing the Shia view that all prophets preached monotheism. This moment underscores the unity of divine revelation across eras.
